items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: On November 13, 570 fans dressed in grey tracksuits gathered at the Philadelphia Museum of Art to set a record. The event celebrated 50 years since the iconic film Rocky was released, highlighting its cultural significance. After the record announcement, attendees enjoyed running up the museum steps while chanting Rocky's name.
